name: McConnell Hall
use: Psychology, Sociology, Family Research Lab, COLA offices; formerly Whittemore School of Business and Economics
style: 1960s modernist (concrete frame with deep window grid, per archives photo)

renovations.what: Interior gut renovation after the business school left: central air, entrance academic commons with computer clusters, SMART-screen classrooms; exterior unchanged

facts.text: Built in 1967 and named for John W. McConnell, UNH president 1963–71.
Housed the Whittemore School of Business and Economics until the Paul College building opened in 2013.
A roughly $10 million interior gut renovation added central air and an academic commons at the entrance, leaving the exterior as it was.
Psychology moved to the fourth floor, consolidating offices previously split among Conant, Brook Way and Nesmith.
